screen: County-held-out one-degree-of-freedom monotone M2 Wikidata-share spline on frozen S1 residual; unregistered

method.outcome: Pinned frozen cross-fitted S1 orthogonalized-disagreement residual; never recomputed or refit.
method.spline: One-degree-of-freedom monotone linear hinge spline: intercept + beta*max(direction*(z - train-median(z)),0), beta constrained nonnegative. z uses training-only mean and SD; median knot is training-only. No internal knots beyond this single median hinge knot.
method.direction: Among nondecreasing and nonincreasing hinge directions, choose lower training SSE only; exact ties select nondecreasing. No held-out residuals influence direction, scaling, knot or coefficient.
method.validation: Within each official region, hold one county FIPS out; fit only on paired-support tracts in all other counties of that region; predict every paired held-out tract once.
method.baseline: Uncorrected frozen S1 residual represented by zero correction prediction; both baseline and spline evaluated on identical held-out support.
method.metric: County-held-out delta-R2=(baseline SSE-spline SSE)/baseline SSE, with baseline SSE=sum(frozen residual^2). Pooled and each region reported.
method.uncertainty: Paired county-block percentile bootstrap with replacement within each region; 2,000 draws, fixed seed.
method.support: Intersection of frozen S1 residual definedness and provided M2 F feature definedness; no imputation.
method.interpretation_limit: Provided-feature residual association only; does not establish hidden-target accuracy, causality, or authorize estimator integration.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-county SSEs; counties sampled with replacement separately within each official region

training_fit.direction_selection: training SSE only; exact tie chooses nondecreasing
